title: Brazilian Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful and hearty stew made with tender chicken and a blend of spices, inspired by Brazilian cuisine.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and browned chicken to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
